name: golden-measure-patisserie-enter-with-no-allies-does-not-crash
notes: On Enter targets an ally; with no allies on either field the generated body queued an MZCHOOSE with an empty option list and MZCountChoices('') called count(null) (TypeError). Fixed in Core/DecisionQueueController (an empty option list is zero choices).

rulesClauses: On Enter: Put a buff counter on target ally.

engineBug.summary: Entering with no allies on the field crashed the engine (count(null) on an empty MZCHOOSE).
